name: ARMST Optics Gameplay Compatibility

principle.real_world_reference: Preserve real weapon/mount/module compatibility as research data.
principle.gameplay_rule: Any optic assigned AttachmentOpticsARMST_DovetailRU may be mounted on any weapon optic slot assigned AttachmentOpticsARMST_DovetailRU.
principle.engine_rule: module AttachmentType must inherit or equal the weapon slot AttachmentType.

AttachmentOpticsARMST_DovetailRU.scope: Russian/Soviet side-rail optics intentionally grouped by ARMST gameplay policy

DovetailRU.rule: PSO-family and other approved Russian side-rail optics are intentionally cross-compatible across DovetailRU weapons.

RIS1913.rule: Keep engine-standard Picatinny/RIS hierarchy; do not merge it into DovetailRU.

example.GameplaySimplification: allowed on every ARMST weapon marked DovetailRU

validation: DovetailRU weapon optic slots must use AttachmentOpticsARMST_DovetailRU.
DovetailRU must not be used for RIS1913/Picatinny-only weapons.
RealCompatibility may be narrower than GameplayCompatibility and must not be overwritten.
Pivot/snap placement is validated independently from AttachmentType.
Changing only the weapon slot is insufficient; the optic/module side must also declare an equal or inheriting AttachmentType.
Prefer thin child optics/modules for gameplay compatibility changes when model, zeroing, reticle, animation and geometry should remain inherited.
migration: Migrate all intended Russian side-rail weapon slots to AttachmentOpticsARMST_DovetailRU.
Create or migrate approved PSO-family ARMST optic children to AttachmentOpticsARMST_DovetailRU.
Keep physical pivot/snap geometry inherited unless geometry itself requires correction.
Keep RIS1913 and G36 types unchanged.
Run compatibility matrix and Workbench/runtime validation.
